newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil ex-military dictator operated by medium.
newsitem.headline: Brazil ex-military dictator operated by medium.

text.p: One of Brazil's former military dictators, Joao Figueiredo, has undergone a spine operation by a man claiming to be a medium for the spirit of a German doctor who died during the First World War.

Figueiredo, 79, under whose leadership Brazil returned to democracy and civilian rule in 1985 after 21 years of military dictatorship, opted for the bizarre treatment because a normal operation was deemed too risky.
The operation was carried out on Tuesday by medium Rubens de Faria, supposedly guided by the spirit of doctor Adolph Fritz, a spokesman for the medium said on Thursday.

"The operation lasted about half an hour. Dr. Fritz made a small incision at the bottom of the spine and gently hammered the vertebrae with a special instrument," the spokesman said. Figueiredo remained awake throughout Tuesday's procedure.

The spokesman said that Figueiredo, who has suffered from back problems for years, was able to walk away from the operating table. Figueiredo is still being monitored to see if he recovers completely from his back pains, he added.

Dr. Fritz, whose spirit is allegedly chaneled by Faria, a 42-year-old electronic engineer, is famous throughout Brazil for miraculous cures, and every week thousands of people in Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo clamour to be operated on by him.
